testCases.testCaseName: Verify Upcoming Anniversaries panel is visible on Buzz after valid login
testCases.description: Open OrangeHRM demo site, log in with valid credentials, navigate to Buzz, verify the 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel is displayed, and print the list of people shown.

expectedValidations: Username and Password input fields are visible
User is authenticated and navigated to the application (e.g., Dashboard/Home)
Buzz page header or identifier is visible
'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel is present in the Buzz page layout
Panel is visible (not collapsed or hidden)

steps.action: Capture and print the list of people with upcoming anniversaries
steps.target: Buzz page - 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel - list items (names)
expectedValidations: All displayed names within the 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel are retrieved
Names are printed/logged in the test output in display order
If no names are present, print/log 'No upcoming anniversaries'

testCases.testCaseName: Negative - Invalid login prevents access to Buzz and Upcoming Anniversaries panel
testCases.description: Attempt to log in with invalid credentials and verify that access to Buzz (and the 'Upcoming Anniversaries' panel) is not granted.

expectedValidations: Username and Password input fields are visible
Login remains on the Login page
Main navigation sidebar is not available

steps.action: Verify Buzz and 'Upcoming Anniversaries' are not accessible
expectedValidations: 'Buzz' menu item is not accessible when not authenticated
User cannot navigate to the Buzz page without a valid session
